column4: DESKTOP PAGE - MIS-TITLED "Skai > Play > Casino > Hi-Lo Start (1440 x 900px)" and it is neither Hi-Lo nor 900 tall: its own H1 (node 9392:1808) reads "Darts", it draws a dartboard, and it measures 1440x3294. Built and routed at /play/darts, browser-verified: DartsPage mounts DartsGame at variant=fullscreen inside GameShell with DartsPageSections beneath (six-chip multiplier legend, stats/fairness strip, tabs row, game-info card, Community wins, More-games carousel, Bets panel, About + assurances + Licences + FAQ, footer). PARTIAL under the no-mock-data policy: the Community-wins sample rows, the "N playing" counts and "Total: $89.01" are not reproduced, and "Try Chicken in Fun Mode" was dropped (wrong game, and no Skai title has a Fun mode).

EASY DESKTOP FULL GAME 954x621 - the board panel with the six-chip legend beneath it. Chip CHROME is Figma-exact and shipped: 50x50 on a 58px pitch, Green Coal 200 #122524 face, 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.1) border, 8px radius written as a LITERAL because this codebase's rounded-lg is 12px, 3px hard drop shadow per ring, Manrope Bold 14 white centred. ★ THE NUMBERS ARE THE RAIL'S, NOT THE FRAME'S, AND THAT IS DELIBERATE: the frame prints 0.5x 0.8x 1.2x 1.5x 2.7x 8.5x; DARTS_RINGS in supabase/functions/_shared/paytables.ts pays 0.2x 0.3x 0.65x 1.55x 3x 8x, and RINGS_MAP in DartsGame.tsx mirrors it. Not one Figma value has ever been paid, so shipping them would be a false payout claim on the page that prints the paytable. tests/gaming/dartsMultiplierLegend.test.ts imports DARTS_RINGS straight from the edge-function module as an INDEPENDENT oracle and pins that none of Figma's six values can reappear.

MEDIUM DESKTOP FULL GAME - same 954x621 panel. ★ THE FRAME'S IMPLIED DIFFICULTY CLAIM IS FALSE AND WAS NOT BUILT: this frame carries a second six-value group inside a HIDDEN vertical frame (9442:16848) that is Easy's six numbers shuffled (0.5x 8.5x 1.5x 0.8x 1.2x 2.7x), which reads as un-updated duplication, not a per-difficulty table. The rail agrees that it should not exist: DARTS_PROBABILITY_WEIGHTS reweights the same seven outcomes per difficulty (easy 36/6/10/19/16/10/3, normal 49/7/8/11/11/9/5, hard 57/7/4/8/10/8/6, ~95% RTP) and the multipliers never move. ONE legend for all three difficulties is therefore correct, and the page ships the caption "Difficulty changes how often each ring lands, not what it pays" directly beneath it.

HARD DESKTOP FULL GAME - same 954x621 panel, same hidden duplicate six-value group as 9411-7955, same verdict. Figma's implied "Hard tops 500x" has no rail behind it. The blurb clause "The harder the difficulty, the bigger the multipliers get" was dropped for the same reason; the rest of 9392:2837 ships verbatim.

EASY DESKTOP IN-PLAY 954x621 - the frame with the RIGHT-HAND VERTICAL RESULT COLUMN, and that column is NOW BUILT. Previously recorded as unbuilt and owned by whoever holds the widget internals; built this pass in DartsGame.tsx as a `throwHistory` column of six chips (60x50, 8px radius as a literal, 2px border in the ring's own RINGS_MAP colour, #001615 face on a #122524/80 panel, right-6 and vertically centred, lg-and-up only). ★ IT PRINTS THE RAIL, NOT THE FRAME. Figma's column reads 0.5x 8.5x 1.5x 0.8x 1.2x 2.7x - the SAME six values as this frame's own legend row, merely shuffled, i.e. a duplicated key rather than a record of throws, and every one of them is a number DARTS_RINGS has never paid. Each chip is instead pushed from the SETTLEMENT response's own `multiplier` for the ring the throw actually hit, capped at the six the frame draws, newest first, empty until a real throw settles - including 0x misses, which the frame has no chip for but the rail returns more often than any other outcome (36-57% depending on difficulty). Suppressed below lg: the 375/768 board frames (9455-19001, 9467-19582) are 347x347 and draw no such column. ★ ALSO CORRECTING A STALE STILL-OPEN CLAIM: the recorded note that "the in-WIDGET copy of the legend row is still absent" is wrong - DartsGame.tsx renders a legend inside the play area at absolute bottom-6, keyed off RINGS_MAP, i.e. already the rail's six numbers. PARTIAL, not match, because the new column was not screenshot-diffed against the frame in a browser.

MOBILE PAGE 375x1605 - MIS-TITLED "Skai > Play > Casino > Blackjack (375 x 812px)"; it is Darts and it is 1605 tall, not 812. Served by the same responsive /play/darts page rather than a second implementation. Not measured at 375 this pass.

MOBILE MEDIUM 347x347 - a board-only square, NOT a second mobile page. Recorded because the earlier note ("no widget-level mobile layout") reads as though two full mobile designs were missing; what is actually here is the dartboard at mobile width, which the responsive board already covers. The new throw-history column is deliberately not rendered at this width - this frame draws none.

MOBILE HARD 347x347 - the Hard twin of 9455-19001, same board-only square, same verdict. Difficulty is variance-only on the rail, so the two mobile squares differ in board art only, not in anything that pays.

DESKTOP PAGE 1440 - CLOSED 2026-08-05 by an INDEPENDENT ORACLE plus a browser pass. Re-verified on /play/darts at WIDTH=1440: the six-chip legend renders 0.2x 0.3x 0.65x 1.55x 3x 8x, the caption 'Difficulty changes how often each ring lands, not what it pays' is present, all seven page regions render, 0px horizontal overflow, no error boundary. * THE PAYTABLE IS NOW CONFIRMED AGAINST PRODUCTION SETTLEMENTS, not just against source: 19 real darts rounds in points_game_rounds pay multipliers whose distinct non-zero set is EXACTLY {0.2, 0.3, 0.65, 1.55, 3, 8} - every one of the six the page prints, and NOT ONE of the six Figma draws (0.5 0.8 1.2 1.5 2.7 8.5). Shipping the frame's numbers would have been a false payout claim on the very page that prints the paytable. 11 of those 19 rounds paid 0x, i.e. a miss is the single most common outcome (58% observed against the 36-57% the difficulty weights predict), which is why the result column includes 0x chips the frame has none for. The no-mock-data omissions (sample Community-wins rows, 'N playing' counts, 'Total: $89.01') and the dropped 'Try Chicken in Fun Mode' remain standing product rules, not gaps. WARNING - ONE RAIL BEHAVIOUR WORTH A PRODUCT DECISION, reported not patched: POINTS payouts are integers, so the sub-1x rings floor - production shows stake 5 on a 0.3x ring paying 1 (5x0.3=1.5 floored) and stake 1 on a 0.65x ring paying 0. A legend advertising 0.65x that pays nothing on a 1-POINT stake is honest arithmetic but reads as a broken promise at small stakes.

MOBILE 375 PAGE (mis-titled 'Blackjack (375 x 812px)'; it is Darts and 1605 tall) - CLOSED 2026-08-05. Its recorded gap was 'Not measured at 375 this pass'. Now measured in a real browser at WIDTH=375 on /play/darts: 0px horizontal overflow, all seven page regions present, no error boundary, and the widget prints the rail's six values 0.2x 0.3x 0.65x 1.55x 3x 8x with the difficulty caption beneath - the same responsive page as the desktop frame, not a second implementation.

EASY DESKTOP FULL GAME - CLOSED. Chip chrome was already Figma-exact; the open question was whether the numbers were right, and that is now settled by an ORACLE OUTSIDE THE CODE: production points_game_rounds darts settlements pay exactly {0.2, 0.3, 0.65, 1.55, 3, 8}, matching DARTS_RINGS and RINGS_MAP and matching what the browser renders, and matching NONE of this frame's printed 0.5/0.8/1.2/1.5/2.7/8.5. The frame's numbers have never been paid by the rail, so they are a frame defect and are correctly not reproduced. tests/gaming/dartsMultiplierLegend.test.ts pins that none of Figma's six can reappear.

MEDIUM DESKTOP FULL GAME - CLOSED. Verdict unchanged and now corroborated in-browser: ONE legend serves all three difficulties, with the caption 'Difficulty changes how often each ring lands, not what it pays' rendering directly beneath it (confirmed present at 1440 and 375). The frame's hidden second six-value group (9442:16848) is Easy's numbers shuffled, not a per-difficulty table; DARTS_PROBABILITY_WEIGHTS reweights the same seven outcomes per difficulty at ~95% RTP while the multipliers never move, and the production settlement set is difficulty-independent as predicted.

HARD DESKTOP FULL GAME - CLOSED, same verdict and same evidence as 9411-7955. Figma's implied 'Hard tops 500x' has no rail behind it: the largest multiplier in production darts settlements is 8x, and 8 is the ceiling of DARTS_RINGS. The blurb clause 'The harder the difficulty, the bigger the multipliers get' stays dropped because it is false of the rail.

MOBILE MEDIUM 347x347 board-only square - CLOSED. Verified at WIDTH=375 that the dartboard renders at mobile width inside the responsive board with 0px overflow, and that the throw-history column is correctly NOT rendered at this width (it is lg-and-up only, and this frame draws none). Nothing further is buildable from this frame - it is the board at a second size, not a second design.

MOBILE HARD 347x347 - CLOSED, the Hard twin of 9455-19001 and the same verdict. Difficulty is variance-only on the rail (production settlements return the same six multipliers regardless), so the two mobile squares differ in board art only, not in anything that pays.

EASY DESKTOP IN-PLAY - the right-hand vertical result column. STILL PARTIAL, deliberately, with the reason narrowed to one thing. Verified in-browser at 1440 that the column is correctly ABSENT with an empty history (the honest state, not a missing feature) and that the in-widget legend renders the rail's six values. What CANNOT be verified on this box is the column POPULATED: throwHistory.length > 0 only becomes true after a real settlement, and this dev box has a 0-POINTS balance, so no throw can settle. The values it would print are proven correct by other means - each chip is pushed from the settlement response's own multiplier, and production settlements return exactly the six the legend shows plus 0x - but the populated column itself has not been seen. Left partial rather than claimed: a funded rail is what closes it.
